reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Write dedupe cache is deprecated: Write dedupe cache is deprecated because it not required by the newer single store indexes (TSDB and boltdb-shipper)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: Write dedupe cache is deprecated and will be removed in Loki 4.0; environments using legacy index types must migrate to TSDB before upgrading to Loki 4.0.

proposed.statement: Write dedupe cache is deprecated in Loki 3.0.0 because it is not required by newer single store indexes (TSDB and boltdb-shipper); users with legacy index types must migrate to TSDB to use Loki 4.0.
